about: A tool that finds the changed lines in a branch that have no test coverage.

prs.title: LCOV reports work from a subfolder
prs.broken: Run from a subfolder of the repo, diff-cover matched no files in an LCOV report and passed a coverage check it should have failed.
prs.changed: Paths in LCOV reports are now read from the folder the tool ran in, or as absolute paths.
prs.matters: Coverage gates on LCOV reports catch untested code again.
